parakeet: As this pattern is reinforced, you start being sought out during services. People say, What is God showing you today? You feel pressure to discern something, even when you're simply reading the room. You begin to second guess yourself when you don't feel something, because that must mean you're not in tune. The irony, you're more in tune than anyone else, but not with heaven, with the room. When your perception becomes prophecy, you start doubting your cognitive instincts and relying instead on spiritual scripts. You lose trust in natural knowing and start searching for supernatural confirmation. You start ignoring logic, intuition, or psychology because you've been told that those are fleshly or carnal. Over time, you lose your grounding. You become a mouthpiece for other people's expectations, not your own observations. What they called prophetic was actually just perceptive.
